## Overview

The cardiac cycle is the sequence of mechanical and electrical events that repeats with every heartbeat, divided into **systole** (contraction and ejection) and **diastole** (relaxation and filling).

## Phases

- Isovolumetric contraction
- Ventricular ejection
- Isovolumetric relaxation
- Ventricular filling

Replace this text with the real depth this project is for — pressure-volume relationships, the Wiggers diagram, valve mechanics, and how each phase shows up on an ECG and a heart sound exam.
